messages:
mira_fin: Received a ticket from Acme Labs — their usage this month is ~2.4M tokens higher than they see internally. They suspect double-counting. I can't find a clear spike on their side.

thomas_ops: pinging infra — any recent changes to edge proxies or CDN behavior?

kevin_ingest: we rolled a new http2 -> http1 proxy middleware on 2027-11-10 to address keepalive regressions. It changes how chunked responses are proxied and adds a small retry on 5xx.

julia_support: customer says the discrepancy started Nov 10 around 09:12 UTC. matches your deploy window kevin.

kevin_ingest: digging into metering stream: I see duplicate emit events for a subset of request_ids where client retried but upstream also replayed the request. Example lines: 
```
request_id=zz9a status=200 emit=true
request_id=zz9a status=200 emit=true duplicate_of=zz9a
```

kevin_ingest: looks like when middleware converted streaming chunks it sometimes closed the client connection mid-chunk, client retried, upstream treated both as valid and emitter didn't dedupe because request_id header changed in one case.

mira_fin: what's the scale? we need a dollar estimate before flagging invoices.

kevin_ingest: running a quick aggregation. ETA 15m.

metering-bot: Alert: high-duplicate-rate detected on partition p-12 between 2027-11-10T09:10Z and 2027-11-10T09:40Z. duplicates=24123 events.

kevin_ingest: summary query: 
```
SELECT count(*) as total_emits, count(distinct request_id) as unique_requests
FROM emit_events
WHERE bucket >= '2027-11-10T09:00' AND bucket < '2027-11-10T10:00' AND partition='p-12';
```

kevin_ingest: results: total_emits=124,112 unique_requests=99,989 => duplicates ~24,123. Estimated extra tokens ~2,430,000 tokens => ~$2,430 at $0.001/token (embeds-equivalent).

mira_fin: ouch. Acme Labs has been invoiced for whole month already (INV-ACME-20271101). We need to propose resolution. Options: reverse duplicate events from metering, issue credit, or perform a safe dedupe backfill and regenerate invoice.

thomas_ops: priority is to ensure metering accuracy and avoid double-charging. We should run a dedupe backfill that inspects original logs and tags duplicate emits with dedup=true so billing ignores the duplicates. Backfill job ID BF-3902. Risk: backfill might reprocess ~2.4M tokens and could take several hours, but it should be safe.

julia_support: customer wants immediate communication. Suggest we offer provisional credit while we backfill.

mira_fin: proposing provisional credit 100% of estimated duplication $2,430 pending backfill verification. Approve?

thomas_ops: approve up to $3,000 provisional credit. Also need ops to add a dedupe metric and create an incident runbook for this class of middleware-induced duplicates.

kevin_ingest: started BF-3902 at 2027-11-11T02:05Z. It will: 1) scan raw request logs for duplicate payloads within 2-minute windows; 2) emit dedupe markers to metering topic; 3) produce reconciliation report. Running now.

metering-bot: Backfill BF-3902: progress 25% (approx 600k tokens marked).

kevin_ingest: found root cause: our proxy was not preserving x-request-id consistently under certain stream aborts; client libraries then generated new ids on retry causing emitter to treat as independent. Fix PR open: infra/remove-proxy-rewrite-ids #1426.

mira_fin: finance note: create JIRA FIN-1133 and billing-adjustments card for provisional credit. I'll draft customer note.

julia_support: Draft to customer: "Hi — we detected duplicate metering events for a small portion of requests after an edge proxy change on Nov 10. We're backfilling and deduping your billed usage and will apply a credit for the duplicated amount. We estimate the impact to be ~$2.4k and will confirm once backfill completes. Apologies for the noise." ok to send provisional?

mira_fin: yes send as investigating. include BF-3902 and FIN-1133 ref.

kevin_ingest: backfill completed at 2027-11-11T05:50Z. BF-3902 report: duplicates_marked=24,123 extra_tokens=2,430,200. reconciliation id = ACME-RECON-20271111.

metering-bot: BF-3902: success. duplicates_marked=24123.

mira_fin: since backfill succeeded, we'll void the duplicate emits so invoice INV-ACME-20271101 will be adjusted. finance will issue a credit memo CM-ACME-20271111 for $2,430.20 (incl. rounding).

julia_support: customer replied :thumbsup: and asked what precautions we will take.

thomas_ops: action items: 1) merge PR #1426 to stop proxy rewriting ids; 2) add emitter dedupe check (idempotency via x-request-id and payload checksum); 3) add monitoring alerting for duplicate rate >0.5% per partition.

mira_fin: closing FIN-1133 once credit memo posted. thanks all.
